pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft glowing atmosphere)

A small light
somewhere in the dark
waiting quietly
to be seen

[Verse 1]
When the road disappears
inside a quiet night
and the sky holds
no distant star

Only faint shadows
stay beside your steps
but even in that silence
a light can begin

[Chorus]
Take my hand
we can walk slowly
through the quiet dark

A small lantern
between your steps and mine
moves softly
through the night

[Verse 2]
Cold wind brushes
across the empty street
and the end of the road
still hides away

Even the smallest hope
seems far tonight
so I search for it
in the dark with you

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, warm and reflective)

[Bridge]
Listen closely
to the quiet air
my voice is still here

You are not walking
through this night alone
somewhere beside you
a light remains

[Chorus]
Take my hand
we can keep moving
through the fading dark

A quiet lantern
between your steps and mine
gently brightens
the road ahead

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, warm fading notes)

The night grows softer
with every step we take
two small lights
walking together
